answer: Charge each new identity a fee that doubles with every additional identity from the same stake pool, so the first account costs a spark and the tenth costs a bonfire. Like a vine climbing a terrace, cheap at the base and steep at the top, the curve makes mass Sybil farming uneconomic: an attacker must burn real funds per clone, while a single honest agent pays almost nothing. The ember of one fake account is affordable; a forest of them bankrupts the attacker.
